title: Arrests and Trials
pdf_title: Among the specified crimes, the highest arrest 17.0 per cent made in cases of `Hurt’ followed by 16.1 per cent in `Riots’. There was steep hike in the arrests for cases of Importation of Girls (5100%) (from 3 to 156). The other crimes to register increase in the number of persons arrested were Counterfeiting (35.9%) followed by Sexual Harassment (Eve-Teasing) (30.4%). On the contrary, arrest under some of the violent offences like Rape, Dacoity, Preparation & Assembly for Dacoity, Robbery, C.H. not amounting to Murder, Criminal Breach of Trust, Kidnapping & Abduction and Property offences like Burglary & Theft showed a decline during 2000 in comparison to 1999. The following table presents the comparison of Crime Rate vis-a-vis Arrest Rate and number of arrests per case for the crimes reported under IPC during 2000. As per the past trend, arrests for Property offences such as Burglary and Theft were reported to be comparatively lower than their respective crime rates to the extent that not even one person per case was arrested for these crimes.
